full_name: Hans Tutschku | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Arts Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music Harvard University
bio: Hans Tutschku is the Fanny P. Mason Professor of Music at Harvard University, where he has overhauled the program in electroacoustic composition since his arrival, in 2004. He studied composition in Birmingham, Dresden, The Hague, and Paris and has been a member since 1982 of Ensemble für Intuitive Musik Weimar, with which he has toured more than 30 countries.
